description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrifice Su-Chi.
Su-Chi and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger by paying {4}, returning Su-Chi to the battlefield and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer trigger, scrying 1.
Repeat.
